استبدعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْدَعُوا (istabdaʕū) /is.tab.da.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْدَعَ (istabdaʕa)
# اُسْتُبْدِعُوا (ustubdiʕū) /us.tub.di.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَبْدَعَ (istabdaʕa)
# اِسْتَبْدِعُوا (istabdiʕū) /is.tab.di.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْدَعَ (istabdaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
